[P3] Also clear the failure-count threshold when collecting all results

These conditions still allow `{ toleratedFailurePercentage: 100, toleratedFailureCount: 0 }`, which completes on the first failure because `shouldContinue()` checks the count threshold independently. Readers adapting the earlier example, which sets `toleratedFailureCount`, can therefore still abandon items despite following this guidance. Include `toleratedFailureCount` among the fields that must be unset.
